ohtani.title: Roki Sasaki dominates Mets in Dodgers' 4-2 win
ohtani.blurb: Roki Sasaki strikes out nine across seven dominant innings and Kyle Tucker hits a home run in the Dodgers' 4-2 win over the Mets

imanaga.title: Imanaga, Hoerner lead Cubs to 10-1 win
imanaga.blurb: Seven shutout innings from Shota Imanaga, and a two-hit, four-RBI day from Nico Hoerner propel the Cubs to a 10-1 win over the Twins

suzuki.title: Matthew Boyd remains steady in Cubs 3-2 win
suzuki.blurb: Matthew Boyd tosses seven scoreless innings,  Swanson and Crow-Armstrong provide offense in the Cubs' extra-innings win over the Pirates

yoshida.title: Seigler's four-hit game lead offense in Red Sox's win
yoshida.blurb: Anthony Seigler's lead off home run, first career four-hit game and Rony Gonzalez's go-ahead eighth-inning RBI double power the Red Sox to a 6-4 win over the Blue Jays

okamoto.title: Seigler's four-hit game lead offense in Red Sox's win
okamoto.blurb: Anthony Seigler's lead off home run, first career four-hit game and Rony Gonzalez's go-ahead eighth-inning RBI double power the Red Sox to a 6-4 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Astros mark eight runs in comeback win vs. White Sox
murakami.blurb: Cam Smith homers and Christian Walker hits a three-run double in an eight-run 6th inning as the Astros defeat the White Sox, 9-5

matsui.title: Braves hit four homers in 6-5 win vs. Padres
matsui.blurb: Dominic Smith, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II and Drake Baldwin hit home runs and Chris Sale fans 11 in the Braves' 6-5 win over the Padres
